description: This Java class implements an asynchronous command executor in the Fineraft project, utilizing CompletableFuture to run command processing asynchronously with middleware invocation and routing.

classes.name: AsynchronousCommandExecutor
classes.description: A Spring component implementing command execution asynchronously using CompletableFuture, with middleware processing before routing and handling the command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously, runs through middlewares, routes to the appropriate handler, and returns a Supplier of the result that waits for completion.
